name: צְמָרִי
summary: The Zemarites, a clan among the families of Canaan; the definite singular names the whole clan. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The Zemarite stands between the Arvadite and the Hamathite in the list described as the families of the Canaanite.

note: Moved from the former word entry `9emaariy` (old root key צמר). A tie to צֶמֶר “wool” is not shown.
